newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea seen supporting won - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea seen supporting won - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen stepping into the interbank market in early Tuesday morning trading to boost the won against the dollar after the domestic unit fell to the 848 level, dealers said.
The central bank denied its intervention, as it routinely does.
The won is being pressured by import settlements and the dollar's strength on world markets. Dealers said the local currency is expected to continue to weaken barring the central bank's support.
Shortly after the intervention, the won was trading at 847.90. It opened the day at 848.00
